verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a real MCP server/AI editor integration enabling natural-language queries, feature flag shipping, and stack-trace debugging via plain-text prompts (posthog-docs-19, posthog-docs-12, posthog-docs-24, posthog-probe-4), plus PostHog AI writing Hog functions. However, hands-on community feedback reports the LLM/cohort feature failing to execute basic requests and causing severe performance issues, undercutting vendor claims of smooth natural-language operation.
